status: Native source quartet and static QA complete; coordinator formal export/integration pending
nativeArtPolicy: Every selected and rejected raw/master is byte-identical. No cleanup, painting, recoloring, cropping, per-pose rescaling or source padding. QA composites and technical export proposals are separate only.
palettePolicy: Original warm medium-brown female skin, black braid, brown lamp helmet/gloves/boots, charcoal coat, brown belt, brass-yellow lantern, wood-and-gray pick. Broad soot shapes retained; no faction recolor.
semanticContract: idle/walk-a/carry-or-work/walk-b. Purposeful noncombat lantern/pick handling. Catalog availability does not imply authored gameplay use or permission to invent rules.

rejectedAttempts.reason: Pose reproduces the same screen-right forward heel-raised/sole-visible step as walk-a; opposite walking support is insufficiently clear. Identity/alpha not reason for rejection. No edited or cleaned derivative used.

idle.review: Both boots planted. Screen-left near hand hangs original lantern beside leg; screen-right far hand holds original pickaxe upright. Same female face, braid, brown lamp helmet and charcoal workwear.

walk-a.review: Screen-right front boot reaches heel-first with toe raised and sole visible; screen-left rear boot supports with toe/sole down. Lantern swings slightly back in original near hand; pick remains in original far hand.

carry-or-work.review: Both boots planted; torso leans toward work. Original screen-left near hand raises hanging lantern to waist, original screen-right far hand lowers pick horizontally/outward into a controlled inspection/preparation action. No new objects or prop-hand swap.

walk-b.review: Screen-right front boot flat and weight-bearing; screen-left rear heel raised and knee bent, toe at ground. Opposite support/contact to walk-a. Lantern and pick remain in original physical hands.
